name: Post-flush stabilization entry (15m long the basing, not the knife)
rationale: MECHANISM: H1 buys the flush instant and risks catching a falling knife on the rare cascade that keeps going (Oct-2025 accelerated 14.6x mid-event). This variant waits ONE regime beat — OI has ALREADY collapsed (flush happened) AND price has begun to base: range_position lifting off the lows and rsi curling up from oversold. The counterparty is late/algorithmic dip-sellers still hitting bids AFTER the forced flow is exhausted — you buy from them once the non-economic seller is confirmed gone, trading a slightly worse entry for a much lower hit-rate-of-disaster. Edge = the confirmed-exhaustion subset of H1 where the V is already forming. Entry: open_interest below a floor (flush already occurred) AND range_position cross_up through a low floor (lifting off the session low) AND rsi cross_up through an oversold-exit level (momentum curling up) AND vol_realized below a ceiling (vol compressing post-flush). DISCONFIRMER: ablate against H1 on the SAME sample — if waiting does NOT improve tail/maxDD or net Sharpe, the confirmation is pure lag costing the best entries (kill this, keep H1); and if range_position cross_up ALONE (no OI arm) matches, this is generic bottom-fishing not a flush edge. Must beat buy-and-hold net of fees.
catalyst: post-flush basing: OI already collapsed, price lifting off lows, RSI curling up, vol compressing
